objects.title: Change Watch Alert Rule
objects.description: Personal alert subscription rules for Zendesk Change Watch.

fields.title: Owner User ID
fields.description: Zendesk user ID of the rule owner.

fields.title: Module Key
fields.description: Configuration module key matched by this rule.

fields.title: Action Key
fields.description: Audit action key matched by this rule.

fields.title: Enabled
fields.description: Whether this alert rule is active.

fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Optional note describing why this rule exists.

objects.title: Change Watch Read State
objects.description: Per-user read receipts deduplicated by Zendesk Audit Log event ID.

fields.title: User ID
fields.description: Zendesk user ID who read the alert.

fields.title: Audit Event ID
fields.description: Zendesk Audit Log event ID.

fields.title: Read At
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the alert was marked read.

objects.title: Change Watch Clarification Thread
objects.description: Clarification requests linked to Zendesk Audit Log event IDs.

fields.title: Audit Event ID
fields.description: Zendesk Audit Log event ID.

fields.title: Event Module
fields.description: Classified configuration module key.

fields.title: Event Action
fields.description: Audit action key.

fields.title: Event Source Label
fields.description: Snapshot of the audited item label.

fields.title: Event Summary
fields.description: Snapshot of the audit change description.

fields.title: Event Created At
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the audit event.

fields.title: Requester User ID
fields.description: Zendesk user ID of the person asking for clarification.

fields.title: Requester Name
fields.description: Display name of the requester.

fields.title: Recipient User ID
fields.description: Zendesk user ID of the assigned recipient.

fields.title: Recipient Name
fields.description: Display name of the recipient.

fields.title: System Event
fields.description: Whether the original audit event was initiated by System or an inaccessible actor.

fields.title: Question
fields.description: Initial clarification question.

fields.title: Status
fields.description: Thread status: open or resolved.

fields.title: Resolved At
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when resolved.

fields.title: Resolved By User ID
fields.description: Zendesk user ID who resolved the thread.

fields.title: Last Activity At
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the latest update or reply.

objects.title: Change Watch Clarification Reply
objects.description: Replies posted inside Change Watch clarification threads.

fields.title: Thread Record ID
fields.description: Record ID of the parent cw_clarification_thread.

fields.title: Audit Event ID
fields.description: Zendesk Audit Log event ID.

fields.title: Author User ID
fields.description: Zendesk user ID of the reply author.

fields.title: Author Name
fields.description: Display name of the reply author.

fields.title: Reply Body
fields.description: Reply text.

fields.title: Replied At
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the reply.
